prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary photograph inside a working night ferry engine room. The primary subject is one unmistakably adult marine engineer whose recognizable facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and adult age presentation follow Image 1; Image 1 supplies appearance and identity only, while this scene supplies every expression and relationship cue. Show a verified-safety relief display: verified-safety relief immediately after a non-graphic bilge-pump alarm. Keep this cue in frame: a fading amber alarm beacon remains visible beside a dry inspection port. The engineer checks an analog pressure gauge whose needle sits clearly in the green band; an adult colleague points to a steady green status indicator and gives a clear confirming nod. Only after that verification, both of the engineer's shoulders visibly drop, the jaw unclenches, the eyelids soften, and the gloved hand relaxes its grip on a torque wrench. The engineer lowers the torque wrench away from the valve housing and resumes marking a clipboard checklist. Frame this as a medium-wide, slightly low oblique documentary view so the face, shoulders, gauge, colleague, and lowered tool share one focal hierarchy. Cool overhead fluorescence models the face and damp steel while restrained amber spill separates the prior alarm from the green safe status.
negative_en: over-processed retouching, cartoon style, broken facial features, excessive HDR, low resolution, body distortion, fake-looking background, unrealistic hands, flat collage look, inconsistent shadows, unmatched lighting, obvious cutout edges, CGI look, digital illustration
